headlines.title: Kentucky governor tells Mitch McConnell: Prove you can serve or ‘resign’
headlines.description: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear is giving Sen. Mitch McConnell, R-Ky., an ultimatum, demanding that he prove he’s still capable of serving in the U.S. Senate — or resign.

headlines.title: Trump hasn’t asked the Supreme Court to rehear birthright citizenship case despite his vow
headlines.description: President Donald Trump doesn’t appear to have followed through on his vow to convince the Supreme Court to reconsider its ruling on birthright citizenship.

headlines.title: Washington says goodbye to Sen. Lindsey Graham, a ‘true American original’
headlines.description: A special ceremony at the Capitol and a funeral service at the National Cathedral on Tuesday will be private, but both events will be livestreamed for the public.

headlines.title: Kentucky Gov. Beshear demands 'transparency and honesty' on McConnell's health
headlines.description: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear told reporters that constituents are asking for “transparency and honesty” regarding the health of Sen. Mitch McConnell. “We have seen rampant speculation across social media and elsewhere, it could all be fully avoided, and it's all within Senator McConnell's power,” Beshear said. “But because he won't do that, the fact is that we don't know, and that means that the Senate, if he won't provide more evidence, needs to step in and demand it.”

headlines.title: Trump recalls rocky start to friendship with Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: During his tribute to the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, President Donald Trump reflects on the rocky start to their friendship amid the Republican primaries for the 2016 presidential election.

headlines.title: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham during the funeral service at Washington National Cathedral. The president recalled their past working together and previous rivalry running against each other in 2016.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Netanyahu joins Trump for high-stakes meeting at the White House
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to meet with President Donald Trump and attend the late Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral.

headlines.title: Witness in Reflecting Pool case conceded damage before canoeist touched water
headlines.description: A key grand jury witness in a case against a former Olympic canoeist accused of tampering with the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool testified that the area was already damaged and would have required repairs regardless, lawyers said in a court filing.

headlines.title: Can Susan Collins defy political gravity again? From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Trump, Congress and world leaders to honor the late Sen. Lindsey Graham in Washington
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will be in attendance Tuesday. A funeral service in South Carolina will follow Wednesday.

headlines.title: Citing ‘common sense,’ James Comey’s team urges judge to toss seashells case
headlines.description: Attorneys for the former FBI director say the indictment “targets and chills core political speech and fails as a matter of law.”
